description: Commercially usable public test clips for the AI Test Lab (Wikimedia Commons; Public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA only). Split 'test': never tune thresholds or train on these. Downloaded by `python scripts/guardian/fetch_wildlife_videos.py --registry config/lab/videos.json --out data/lab/videos` (licence and SHA-1 re-checked against Commons). Unlabelled unless present_s/absent_s are given; label in the Test Lab. Clips showing real incidents involving harm to people were deliberately excluded. Selected 2026-10-17.
